title: KSquad chart values
description: Schema teeth for the values this chart must never silently accept. Scoped (ISI-2252, §9.4): it validates the workspace access-mode enum so a typo fails `helm install` up front instead of producing a PVC that never binds. RWX is a VALID enum member — the schema cannot verify a StorageClass supports it offline, so RWX is not rejected here; the chart WARNS on it at render (NOTES.txt) instead. Unconstrained keys are intentionally permissive so this schema never blocks unrelated values.

accessMode.description: PVC access mode the operator stamps on every per-Project workspace PVC (§9.4). ReadWriteOnce (RWO) is the default and works on every class (worktree-per-Run). ReadWriteMany (RWX) enables true parallel-Run writes but only where the StorageClass supports it (CephFS/NFS/Azure Files/EFS) — pre-flight it; the chart warns on RWX at render. ReadWriteOncePod restricts the PVC to a single pod (K8s >= 1.29).
